description: This file defines a Product class used in the admin web layer of a shopping application. It encapsulates product details such as descriptions, availability, pricing, images, and associated core product data.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Serializable class representing a product, including descriptions, availability, pricing, and image data for admin operations.

methods.name: getDateAvailable
methods.description: Returns the date when the product is available.

methods.name: setDateAvailable
methods.description: Sets the date when the product is available.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the core product model object.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Sets the core product model object.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of product descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of product descriptions.

methods.name: getProductPrice
methods.description: Returns the product price as a string.

methods.name: setProductPrice
methods.description: Sets the product price as a string.
